# agent-core — Single Source of Truth

_Applies when: editing agent-core itself — or hitting one of its defects from a consumer project. Bootstrapping and content/showcase work live in `55-templates`._

## agent-core is canonical — and you often cannot write where the fix belongs

- agent-core is the single source of truth for rules, skills, subagents, and MCP servers.
  Authoritative paths: `shared/rules/*.md`, `shared/skills/`, agent definitions, `shared/mcp/servers.json`.
- Rules sync into every project (`agent-core sync --scope global|project`) and concatenate into
  each project's CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md. A rule used in its area must therefore BE the agent-core
  rule — fix it upstream here, then sync; never fork rule text into a project.
- Every rule carries an `_Applies when:_` scope line so projects/agents pick only the relevant ones.
- **Report it in the moment of the finding** — a consumer cannot edit agent-core (`sync` overwrites
  what it ships at every session start), and `22-session-close` step 6 is only the safety net.
  Standing approval, bound to this repo + label, never inline; `file:line` / output / a measured
  number is the **admission condition**. Bridge it locally and link the issue; if the fix lives in
  another repo, say so — agent-core submits a PR there, it cannot merge one.
  `gh issue list --repo gmolike/agent-core --label skill-improvement --search "<terms>"`, then `gh issue create --repo gmolike/agent-core --label skill-improvement`.
- **A key can have a foreign owner too** — establish who runs it, then emit through *their* key:
  seed-only checks whether a key is **missing**, not who runs it, and a foreign reset is silent ("Knowledge & Decisions").

## Two distribution targets

- Build both tracks from the same source on a version tag: Claude Code (npm package via
  GitHub Packages, `@gmolike/agent-core`) and OpenCode (`.tgz` bundle on the Release).
- Hooks are Claude-only; when adding one, add the matching OpenCode plugin under
  `targets/opencode/plugins/`. The `validate` step checks `opencode.json` against the live schema;
  `COMPATIBILITY.md` records shared / Claude-only / OpenCode-only.
